title: Research report bundle
description: The machine-checkable half of a report. The prose report is generated from this, so that every sentence has something behind it.

question.description: The research question in the user's own words.

input.description: Exactly what the user supplied, before any resolution.

resolution_note.description: How the input became this address, and what else it could have meant.

candidates_rejected.description: Same-symbol or same-name candidates considered and ruled out, with addresses.

chain_id_verified.description: Must be true. Read eth_chainId from the endpoint actually used.

documentation_checked.description: Which official documentation was consulted, and when.

block_pin.description: The block the report speaks as of.

config_summary.description: The settings that shaped this run, so a reader knows what was and was not asked for.

scope.description: What part of the investigation this touched.

reason.description: The classified reason, e.g. http_429_rate_limited or archive_state_pruned.

effect.description: What could not be established because of it.

unknowns.description: Questions the run did not answer, stated as questions.

next_checks.description: What to do next, ranked, with the budget each step needs.
